correctness.rationale: Every triangular side proportion p_i is in (0,1/2), and alpha_i=1-p_i is the perimeter fraction of the two sides incident to vertex i. For fractional corner gap M_i=min_j(1-lambda_i(X_j)), the threshold neighborhood has exactly P alpha_i t/N arclength for 0<=t<N; for fixed joint thresholds the disjoint corner neighborhoods give joint survival (1-sum alpha_i t_i/N)^N and independent Exp(alpha_i) limits. The unique full-area inscribed triangle is T; compactness localizes each near-maximal sampled triangle to distinct parent vertices. Barycentric multilinearity yields signed area/A=1-sum u_i+O((sum u_i)^2). A near-corner candidate and a matching maximizing-triple lower bound yield Z_N-sum NM_i=o_P(1). Telescoping the determinant from identity bounds the normalized deficit by 2 sum M_i, including coincident selected corner indices, and exponential marginal tails give uniformly bounded moments of every order, proving fixed positive-real moment convergence. The exact survival for rates r+-d, e^-rt(cosh dt+(r/d)sinh dt), increases strictly with d>0; equal-sum pair averaging and majorization place alpha between (2/3,2/3,2/3) and (1,1/2,1/2), with correct strict/equality/degenerate cases. Finally mu=sum t_i, variance=sum t_i^2, sum alpha_i=2 imply elementary symmetric e2=q and e3=q/2, so the cubic recovers the side proportions. These are analytic arguments, not inferences from finite trials.
residual_risks: The source does not establish rates uniform over shapes approaching degeneracy; asymptotics are fixed-shape.
Finite diagnostic computations do not justify the infinite-N theorem; its force rests on the localization and uniform-integrability arguments.
Numerical simulation cannot certify strict stochastic comparison at all t; the two-rate formula and majorization do.

value.rationale: Maximal 3-point area from a boundary sample is a canonical extremal geometric statistic, different from the area of its entire random hull. Its N^-1 corner-gap law is qualitatively unlike circular U-max Weibull extrema and planar polygonal hull-area N^-2 asymptotics. A sharp simultaneous stochastic comparison over all triangle shapes and recovery of the three unordered side proportions from only two limit moments are natural, exact and independently usable classifications. The six-extreme-point reduction gives a practical finite-sample computational link; it is elementary supporting structure, not the sole claimed value. The result makes no unsupported claim about finite-sample estimation stability.
residual_risks: Quantitative inference rates and noise robustness of moment-based shape reconstruction were not proved.
The upper envelope is attained only as a degenerating-shape limit after N tends to infinity; it is not a theorem uniform across nearly degenerate shapes.

limitations: Fixed nondegenerate triangle, uniform normalized arclength sampling, N to infinity before shape degeneration.
Upper envelope is a limiting thin-triangle supremum, never attained by a positive-area triangle.
No uniform shape convergence rate, finite-sample estimator guarantees, or absolute historical originality certification.
